title: GRACE FOR THE SINS WE NEVER MEANT

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'Now if you as a community unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the Lord gave Moses — any of the Lord's commands to you through him, from the day the Lord gave them and continuing through the generations to come — and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord, along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.'" — Num 15:22-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God now makes provision for sins committed "unintentionally" — the wrongs we do without even realising it. This is a tender detail in the law. God knew that His people would sometimes fail Him not through open rebellion but through ignorance and oversight, and He graciously provided a way for those sins to be covered too.

This should bring us relief and humility at once. Humility, because it reminds us that we sin more than we know. There are wrongs in us we are not even aware of — attitudes, omissions, failures that never register on our conscience. None of us fully sees the depth of our own imperfection. And relief, because God makes provision even for these hidden sins. His mercy reaches further than our awareness of our need.

We might worry: how can I be right with God if I cannot even see all my sin? These verses answer that fear. God's atonement is not limited to the sins we manage to notice and confess. His grace covers the whole, including what we never perceived.

How much more complete is the covering we have in Christ. The blood of Jesus cleanses us from all sin — not only the sins we remember and repent of, but the countless failures we never even recognised. We do not have to live in anxiety, wondering if some forgotten fault will condemn us. Christ's sacrifice is thorough and complete. As David prayed, "Forgive my hidden faults." In Jesus, even those are washed away.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you aware that you sin more than you consciously realise?
2. How does it comfort you that God provides for unintentional sins?
3. How does the completeness of Christ's cleansing free you from anxiety?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I confess that I sin more than I even know. Thank You that Your grace in Christ reaches further than my awareness, cleansing me from all sin, even my hidden faults. Free me from anxiety and let me rest in His complete work. Amen.
